day_shape: 57 items: Trump floats declaring Strait of Hormuz US territory as CENTCOM reports 62 vessels redirected under US blockade, six killed in Israeli strike on southern Lebanon's Ansar, Canada sanctions five Iranian officials, and IRIB/Defa Press amplify IRGC commander Wahdii's 'brought most heavily armed army to its knees' message.

threads.label: Hormuz blockade and Trump territorial claim
threads.summary: Trump said he would soon declare the Strait of Hormuz US territory, with Jerusalem Post reporting shipping traffic below monthly average and satellite imagery showing oil slicks near Qeshm and Sirri islands. CENTCOM said its forces have redirected 62 commercial vessels, disabled three and boarded two enforcing the US blockade against Iran as of 14 August.

threads.label: Southern Lebanon strikes and Gaza operations
threads.summary: Lebanese media and IRIB reported six killed in an Israeli pre-dawn airstrike on Ansar north of Tyre, with additional strikes on the Ali Taher Ridge over a Hezbollah underground site. The IDF said it killed Hamas Khan Younis brigade company commander Hudhaifa Khaled Suleiman Qawari and a second commander Muhammad Bassam Mushtaha linked to the 7 October attack.

threads.label: IRGC command reshuffle and offensive posture
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press said IRGC commander General Wahdii declared Islamic fighters 'brought the most heavily armed army in world history to its knees', with regime analysts framing Mohsen Rezaei's appointment as SNSC secretary and General Abdollahi as Chief of Staff as a shift to offensive posture. Iran International said the reshuffle exposes political drama beneath the surface as the Trump administration seeks to end the war.

threads.label: Yemen escalation and Red Sea
threads.summary: Yemen's government said Houthi missiles struck the port of Mocha killing four civilians, while UN envoy Hans Grundberg warned the Security Council that Yemen faces its greatest risk of renewed war since 2022. Defa Press separately reported a Yemeni drone strike on Aramco facilities in Najran, Saudi Arabia.

threads.label: Sanctions pressure and economic threats
threads.summary: Trump warned Iran's economy could take a hit days after Treasury Secretary Bessent made a similar threat, and Defa Press said Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand sanctioned five Iranian military and political officials. Iran International cited former US Treasury official Kerri Bitsoff saying sanctions alone cannot topple the Islamic Republic, and reported Tehran's dilemma over raising gasoline prices without repeating 2019 unrest.
